h: FBI reportedly arrests nine Nigerians in cybercrime operation targeting Americans
p: US authorities have reportedly arrested nine Nigerians wanted over online fraud schemes that targeted American victims. Dozens of phones and computers were said to have been seized in the operation. Details of the charges and where the suspects will face court have not been fully released.
more: About 53 devices were reportedly seized during the arrests.
The FBI has in recent weeks published names and photos of wanted Nigerian fraud suspects.
The suspects are expected to answer to charges in the United States.
